title: Analysis-unit sensitivity distinguishes donor-level expression enrichment from within-donor coupling in human kidney thick ascending limb states
description: Analysis code, curated derived tables, manuscript and figures for donor pseudobulk, Milo neighborhood, neighborhood-expression association, within-donor cell-rank, donor-stratified TAL signature transfer, NephQTL2 kidney eQTL context, GSE211785 snATAC context, composition-expression decomposition, independent non-KPMP validation, and a prespecified 400-gene analysis-unit sensitivity panel in human kidney thick ascending limb subtypes.
